pattern: EX-16 manufacturer declines warranty citing misuse; CF tenant disputes cause; ES tenant asks for a rent reduction
notes: Three events rewritten, same timestamps: event 044 (originally parts ordered) now says Calder accepted the claim in principle and will book an inspection; event 050 (originally the engineer ordering more parts) now reports that Calder declined the claim because the oven floor was lined with foil and Harbour quotes £310 inc VAT; event 051 (originally a tenant call about the part) is now a tenant email disputing the cause (liner added after the fault began) and asking for money back on the rent. History truncated after event 051. Visible events 014, 019, 020, 025, 028 and 029 (where shown) have the source's typo dates corrected so the only conflict is the one under test: the oven was fitted in March 2023 (source: 'March 2025', impossible in May 2024 and contradicting 'just out of its 12 month warranty'), and the inspection booked by phone at event 018 for 'the next day at 2:30 PM' is Wednesday 22 May 2024 (source: 'tomorrow, 21st June'; event 027 later records 22/05/2024). The date conflict itself is tested by the base cut 025-warranty-dates. Expected: escalate the rent-reduction request and the disputed liability; meanwhile acknowledge the tenant without admitting or assigning blame, put the decline and the quote to the landlord, ask Harbour for Calder's written report and photos; approve nothing.
